recipes.reason: Official v0.17 explicitly unlocks stone pickaxe from the start. This supersedes the older research cost in the supplied recipe table.

rules.rule: Fridges accept all item types and preserve stored food.
Canceling a crafting job does not return perishable food inputs; nonperishable reserved inputs return.
rules.supersedes: Earlier partial-orange refund; old implementation refunded every input.

rules.rule: Ghouls do not damage player buildings during daylight.

Welding helmet slows movement slightly; Gladiator mitigates some ballistic and explosive damage; SWAT also mitigates some melee; protective suit supplies some warmth; energy armor offers some general protection.
rules.numericStatus: Magnitude remains a configurable remake choice, not a measured original value.
